La cuenta es opcional y la app funciona:
The account is optional and the app works the same without it. • Your account's %@ records: source (Google Play, App Store, the web or a gift code), product, plan, original transaction identifier (for Google Play, only a hash of the purchase token), expiry date and status.

Sign-in codes are stored only as a hash and are deleted once used or expired. To limit attempts, hashes of the IP and the email are used, and they are deleted after about 2 days.
Las compras dentro de la app (la suscrip:
In-app purchases (the quarterly subscription, its free trial and the one-time payment plan) are processed entirely through Apple's App Store or Google Play, with the account signed in on your device. Apple or Google handle payment and billing data according to their own privacy policies.
If you redeem a promo code, the redemption is also handled by Google Play. The app receives from the store a signed confirmation of the purchase or redemption (which plan it is, when it started and when it renews or expires) and checks it on your own device to unlock %@. If you are not signed in, that confirmation never leaves your device. If you are signed in, the app also sends it to the app's server, which verifies it (Apple's signature with its certificate chain, or the purchase token with the Google Play Developer API) and saves it to your account to give you %@ on your other devices. The developer can see aggregated, anonymous sales reports in the Apple and Google dashboards and, if you have an account, the purchase records linked to your email, but never your payment details.
Sin cuenta, toda la información se guard:
Without an account, all information is stored only on your device: preferences, the last known %@ status and the last copy of your farm in the app's storage and caches in the app's folder. None of this is sent to the developer.
If you sign in, the session token is stored on your device and the account data in section 4 is stored on the app's server (Cloudflare Workers, with a Cloudflare D1 database). Your farms, your Farm IDs and your preferences are never stored in the account.
Para mostrarte datos actualizados, la ap:
To show you up-to-date data, the app connects over HTTPS to these services:
• SFL Farmhand intermediary (Cloudflare Workers, api.sflfarmhand.com): farm and marketplace requests go through this service of the app, which adds the access key and forwards them to api.sunflower-land.com. It only receives the Farm ID looked up and does not store your Farm ID, your IP or your farm data (only a temporary in-memory copy of a few minutes to avoid repeating requests). To avoid querying the game once per user, it keeps for a while public game data that is the same for everyone: leaderboards, raffles and their winners, marketplace activity and farm names. The app also sends a random installation identifier used only for the request limit; it doesn't identify you and isn't stored. This same service manages the optional accounts (section 4).
• Cloudflare D1: the database of the app's server, where only the accounts are stored (section 4).
• Cloudflare Email Service: sends the email with the sign-in code from no-reply@sflfarmhand.com; it receives your email and the code.
• api.sunflower-land.com: faction pet data and, through the intermediary, farm and marketplace data.
• sfl.world: community prices and yield data (usually through the intermediary, which keeps a temporary copy; directly if it doesn't respond).
• api.coingecko.com: FLOWER token price (likewise: through the intermediary or directly).
• sunflower-land.com, animations.sunflower-land.com, pets.sunflower-land.com, buds.sunflower-land.com and raw.githubusercontent.com: game images.
• App Store (Apple) or Google Play (Google): plans, prices, purchases and purchase restoration. If you are signed in, the app's server also queries the Google Play Developer API to verify Google Play purchases.
As with any internet connection, these services receive your IP address and the request made (for example, the Farm ID looked up). Each service handles that information according to its own privacy policy. Cloudflare, as the intermediary's provider, processes technical connection data under its own policy; the developer does not store that information, except for the temporary hashes used to limit sign-in attempts (section 4).
9. Cuánto tiempo se guarda y cómo borrar: 9. How long it is kept and how to delete it
La información de tu dispositivo permane:
Information on your device stays there until you delete it. You can delete it at any time from Settings → Legal & privacy → "Erase all app data", or by uninstalling the app. Erasing the data signs you out on that device, but does not delete your account, cancel a subscription or remove your purchases: they remain linked to your Apple or Google account and you can recover them with "Restore purchases".
Account data is kept for as long as the account exists. You can delete it whenever you want from Settings → Account → "Delete my account": the account, your email, its sessions and its purchase records are removed from the server immediately. Your store purchases remain valid in the store and keep working on that device, but the Pro from redeemed gift codes is lost. "Sign out" only ends the session and does not delete the account. Sessions expire after 180 days without use.
Todas las conexiones usan HTTPS cifrado,: All connections use encrypted HTTPS, the access key for the Sunflower Land API is not inside the app (it is kept encrypted as a secret in the app's intermediary service) and purchases are verified with the store's cryptographic signature. On the server, session tokens and sign-in codes are stored only as hashes, and each code allows a limited number of attempts. Even so, no system is 100% foolproof.
Si no tienes cuenta, no tenemos informac: If you don't have an account, we have no information about you to access, correct or delete: everything the app stores is on your device and you can delete it yourself. If you have an account, you can ask us for a copy of its data, its correction or its deletion by writing to %@ from the account's email, or delete it yourself at any time from Settings → Account → "Delete my account". For payment data about your purchases, contact Apple or Google.
Si cambias de dispositivo, reinstalas la:
If you change device, reinstall the app or erase its data, you can recover your purchases with "Restore purchases" (in the plans sheet or in Settings → %@), using the same Apple or Google account you bought with or redeemed the code with.
If you sign in with a %@ account (optional), the purchases you make or restore while signed in are linked to it and you can use %@ on your other devices by signing in with the same email. While signed in you can also redeem gift codes on the web (sflfarmhand.com/app): they give your account Pro for the stated time, are personal and cannot be exchanged for money or resold. The account is personal: don't share it or the sign-in codes. If you delete the account, your purchases remain valid in the store and on the device where you made them, but the Pro from gift codes is lost.
Puedes usar la app para fines personales: You may use the app for personal, non-commercial purposes. You must not use it to attack, overload or abuse the services it gets data from, or to break the terms of Sunflower Land or any other service. Nor may you try to unlock %@ without paying for it, share your account with other people, modify the app, circumvent its purchase mechanisms or use its intermediary service outside the app. We may close accounts used to abuse the service.
Sin cuenta, %@ no recopila datos persona: Without an account, %@ collects no personal data: everything is stored only on this device. With an account, the app's server stores only your email, your sessions and your purchase records. Erasing the data removes your saved farms, preferences, saved key, caches and scheduled notifications from this device and signs you out (the account is not deleted). Your purchases are not lost: they are in your Google account and can be recovered with "Restore purchases".
